source_name: NBS Registre portál (registre.nbs.sk)
why_relevant: Separate NBS registry application hosting professional-competence registers of institutions and persons. Secondary for payments, but a useful pointer to training/certification providers and to individuals moving between SK financial firms.

source_name: NBS legacy site www.nbs.sk/sk/platobne-systemy (archival payment-systems pages)
why_relevant: Pre-redesign NBS site tree still surfacing in search results; holds older oversight and payment-system pages and historical SIPS/TARGET2-SK material no longer linked from the current site. Useful for time-series and for recovering documents whose new URLs moved.

source_name: Národná banka Slovenska – Pilier III: výkazníctvo a zverejňovanie (supervisory disclosure guidance)
why_relevant: The supervisor's own pages define what Slovak banks must disclose and when (Opatrenie NBS č. 16/2014 and successors), which tells the collector exactly which document types exist, their cadence, and the correct Slovak search terms. It anchors the whole cell's collection calendar.

source_name: ÚVO – Profily verejných obstarávateľov (buyer profiles register)
why_relevant: Canonical index mapping each SK contracting authority (Štátna pokladnica, DataCentrum, Slovenská pošta, NBS-adjacent bodies, municipalities) to its published contracts and documents. The main snowballing device for building the buyer actor map for this cell.

source_name: ÚVO — Zoznam hospodárskych subjektov / registers of economic operators
why_relevant: Public Procurement Office registers of qualified economic operators (and the historic register of beneficial owners it maintained before RPVS). Identifies which vendors are formally pre-qualified to bid for SK public/state-bank IT and payments tenders, and links names to IČO for tender-side analysis.

source_name: FINAS – Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia (membership directory)
why_relevant: FINAS site states 70+ member companies spanning payments, blockchain, banking software, consulting and insurtech (named examples seen: VISA, 365.bank, Akcenta, Crypto Voucher, ANASOFT, DigFin, FinReg Partners). A member roster exposes an entire cohort of SK payments actors and their partners in one place, years before some appear in statutory registers.

source_name: FINAS - Fintech & Insurtech Association of Slovakia
why_relevant: Second SK fintech/insurtech association; co-organises FinTech Roadmap with the Czech associations and appears as a Finweek side-events partner. Membership and event co-branding reveal cross-border CZ/SK vendor alignments.

source_name: Obchodný register SR (ORSR) – bank and IT-subsidiary entity extracts
why_relevant: Authoritative registry establishing legal form, branch status and statutory bodies for every actor in this cell — essential to tell a Slovak a.s. (SLSP, VÚB, Tatra banka, ČSOB, 365.bank, Prima banka) from a pobočka zahraničnej banky (UniCredit SK, mBank SK), which determines what each is obliged to disclose locally.

source_name: AmCham Slovakia — members directory and committees
why_relevant: Directory of members (annually updated, with business descriptions) plus ~15 committees/working groups (Digital Committee, Tax, Public Procurement, Rule of Law). Membership and sponsorship of AmCham events is a weak but real signal of who sells into SK financial services.

source_name: Slovensko.Digital platform – CRZ data mirrors / API discussion threads
why_relevant: Community meta-source that catalogues who mirrors CRZ and how: uvostat's API and rate limits, historical bulk CSV (crz_dokumenty.zip, ~1.2M rows of contract names/file URLs/sizes), a torrent-distributed crz.sql.gz SQL dump, and the important caveat that these dumps carry metadata, not the ~1TB of PDF documents. Fastest route to a legal bulk-ingestion strategy without reinventing it, and it snowballs to the wider Slovensko.Digital open-data ecosystem (ekosystem.slovensko.digital).

source_name: ITAS — IT Asociácia Slovenska, member directory
why_relevant: Largest SK ICT association, 100+ member companies, filterable by category (infrastructure/cybersecurity, system integration/software, telco, vendor/distributor, consulting). This is the single best enumeration of the IT vendor and integrator universe that sells into SK banks.

source_name: Podnikajte.sk – Porovnanie platobných brán na Slovensku
why_relevant: Mainstream SK SME business portal comparing gateways including bank-owned ones (CardPay by Tatra banka, eCard by VÚB) — captures the bank-acquiring arm layer that pure-fintech comparisons miss.

source_name: SAPIE – Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy (member base, 180+ orgs)
why_relevant: Represents 180+ members: innovative companies, startups, VC funds, angel investors, coworkings and accelerators. Broader than fintech but the single best cross-cutting pointer to SK funders/accelerators whose portfolios contain paytech, and the publisher of the first Slovak innovator map.

source_name: SAPIE — Slovak Alliance for Innovation Economy, member lists
why_relevant: ~200 member companies/organisations across the innovation and digital-economy ecosystem, split into regular and associated members; captures fintech and digital challengers that ITAS misses.

source_name: Slovenská FinTech asociácia (Slovak FinTech Association)
why_relevant: Interest association of legal entities (founded 2018, IČO 51910497) bridging financial services and IT; officers and events point to active fintech vendors. Public member list appears thin, so FinStat/Transparex records of its founding members are the workaround.

source_name: 8h.sk (ex-ISTP, operated by TREXIMA) - vacancy aggregator
why_relevant: Aggregates job ads from across the Slovak web, so a single query surfaces which portals and career pages a given bank or vendor is actually using - a cheap discovery layer for new sources. Operated by TREXIMA, which also produces Slovak labour-market analytics, giving a route to skills-taxonomy data.

source_name: ATMIA Showroom – vendor profiles (NCR Atleos and peers)
why_relevant: Industry-association vendor showroom listing ATM-sector suppliers; a structured pointer to the full vendor set whose SK evidence should then be checked on their own sites.

source_name: Blockchain Slovakia — members
why_relevant: Named member list for the crypto/blockchain cohort in SK; relevant for MiCA-driven bank-adjacent activity and for identifying firms positioning around digital assets and tokenised payments.

entity_name: British Chamber of Commerce in the Slovak Republic
source_name: British Chamber of Commerce in the Slovak Republic (Britcham) — members
why_relevant: ~120 member companies; UK-linked financial services and consultancies active in SK. Complements AmCham for a different vendor cohort.

source_name: Crowdberry investment platform (SK/CZ growth capital, SLSP shareholder)
why_relevant: SK/CZ investment marketplace with two growth funds and ~19+ portfolio companies; Slovenská sporiteľňa became a shareholder — a documented bank–alternative-finance partnership. Portfolio pages are a pointer to fundable SK companies, and the bank tie-up is a case study in itself.

source_name: Crunchbase Slovakia hubs (startups, companies, investors, software)
why_relevant: Canonical SK country slice for funding rounds and investor graphs; the investors hub in particular maps which VCs back SK paytech, which then leads to their portfolio pages (a second-order pointer).

source_name: e-Justice / BRIS — EU Business Registers Interconnection, Slovakia entry
why_relevant: EU-level gateway describing and linking the SK commercial and insolvency registers, and enabling cross-border search of parent entities. Essential when a SK payments/banking vendor entity is a subsidiary of an AT/CZ/DE/NL parent and the group chain must be walked outside SK sources.

source_name: eKariera.sk - employer profile directory
why_relevant: Company-indexed job directory; the /firmy/<slug> structure gives a quick way to enumerate SK employers in the banking sector and to spot smaller banks, leasing arms and processors that a keyword search misses.

source_name: Elioplus – Verifone / Thales channel-partner listings
why_relevant: Third-party aggregator of vendor channel partners, filterable by country; useful as a cross-check when a vendor's own locator is JS-gated, though data freshness is lower than the vendor source.

source_name: ifirmy.sk / FinStat-style SK company registers – CIT and deployer entity profiles
why_relevant: Company registers resolve the legal entities behind the cash-cycle layer (Loomis SK a.s., G4S SK entities, EuroNET Slovakia s.r.o.), giving IČO keys for cross-linking to ÚVO profiles, CRZ contracts and financial statements.

source_name: Innovation Map Slovakia (innovationmapslovakia.sk) – accelerators, funding, networks
why_relevant: Online database of SK innovation-ecosystem players categorised into network / support / education / funding, with a dedicated Accelerators & Incubators section. Directly satisfies the 'accelerators and VC portfolios' half of this cell.

source_name: Jooble Slovakia (sk.jooble.org)
why_relevant: Cross-portal aggregator with high SEO reach; useful for retrospective discovery (finding an ad after it has been rotated off the original portal) and for enumerating which employers post banking roles at all. Aggregated copies must be traced back to the original posting before being treated as evidence.

source_name: NBCB — Non Banking Credit Bureau (operator of NRKI)
why_relevant: Interest association of non-bank lenders (~32 members) operating the NRKI register and exchanging data with SRBI since 2015. Its member list maps the non-bank consumer-credit and leasing universe — a distinct buyer segment for POS/credit systems.

source_name: Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry — Slovakia and TED publications
why_relevant: Registry entries describe exactly what SK and TED contracting datasets contain, their coverage, format and download endpoints — the fastest way to choose a stable ingestion path instead of guessing at portal exports.

source_name: OPIS dodávatelia – historic dataset of Slovak IT programme suppliers
why_relevant: Independent compilation of which firms (Soitron, Ditec, Gratex etc.) supplied the large SK informatisation programme; a durable archival map of the local prime-contractor landscape and its consortium habits.

source_name: Partnerbase – Verifone partnership graph
why_relevant: Maps vendor-to-vendor and vendor-to-integrator partnerships; helps reconstruct the alliance layer around POS/ATM vendors active in SK when neither party issues a press release.

source_name: PaymentProviders.io / PayAtlas – international PSP directories with SK country pages
why_relevant: English-language aggregator directories offering SK-filtered provider lists and country compliance/fee overviews; useful for cross-checking the domestic actor map and for spotting cross-border PSPs targeting SK merchants. Directory accuracy is uneven — validate against the NBS register.

source_name: poistovne.sk – Slovak insurer directory and news
why_relevant: Insurance counterpart of banky.sk: per-insurer profile pages (Allianz-SP, Union, etc.) plus articles on digital claims handling. Use it to enumerate SK insurers and locate each one's press page, which is otherwise hard to find.

source_name: Recruiteri.sk - directory of Slovak job servers and recruiters
why_relevant: Maintained local-language index of Slovak job servers and recruitment agencies. Best single starting point for periodically re-checking whether the portal landscape has shifted, and for enumerating specialist IT/finance recruitment agencies whose own listings often carry the most explicit platform requirements.

source_name: rzof.sk – Register zmlúv, objednávok a faktúr (SMB/municipal publication service)
why_relevant: One of several commercial platforms that small obliged entities (obce, školy, príspevkové organizácie) use to publish contracts. Matters because the long tail of ATM-siting leases and small POS/IT awards is scattered across such platforms rather than CRZ; enumerating the platforms is the way to reach that tail systematically.

source_name: SASS — Slovenská asociácia správcovských spoločností
why_relevant: 7 full and ~18 associated members in collective investment; the associated-member tier is where custodians, distributors and IT/data vendors appear. Bank-owned asset managers link back to the bank universe.

source_name: SBCB — Slovak Banking Credit Bureau (operator of SRBI register)
why_relevant: Bank-owned credit bureau (founded by Slovenská sporiteľňa, VÚB, Tatra banka with CRIF); ~17 member institutions. The member list enumerates lending institutions, and the CRIF relationship is a named vendor dependency in SK bank credit infrastructure.

source_name: Slovensko-nemecká obchodná a priemyselná komora (AHK Slowakei / DSIHK)
why_relevant: ~375 member companies across sectors including services and finance; German-linked vendors and banks (and their SK subsidiaries) surface here. Board/officer roles are explicitly split by function including finance.

source_name: Slovenská kancelária poisťovateľov (SKP)
why_relevant: Statutory bureau of motor insurers, closely tied to SLASPO (shared LinkedIn presence). Membership is compulsory for MTPL insurers, so its list is an authoritative census of that segment; it also procures shared IT systems.

source_name: Thales Cyber & Digital (CPL) – Partner directory / Idemia partner page
why_relevant: Thales partner pages are filterable by country and expose resellers/MSPs; relevant for card issuance, HSM and authentication supply chains into Slovak banks.

source_name: Tracxn – FinTech startups in Slovakia (222-company sector explorer)
why_relevant: Largest single enumerated SK fintech cohort found (222 companies, 36 funded, 10 Series A+, ~$37.2M raised, 5 acquisitions, 2 IPOs; names surfaced include Inforbus, Finax, Blockmate, Innovatrics, VESTBERRY, TrustPay, Datamolino, DigFin). Ideal seed list to snowball into ORSR/NBS.

source_name: Verifone Partner Finder (global partner/reseller locator)
why_relevant: Partner locators reveal the local integrator/reseller layer no public register lists; search results indicate Printec Slovakia (Elektrárenská 4, Bratislava) appears as a Verifone partner for SK — direct evidence of the SK POS channel.

source_name: Webhostingcentrum.sk – comparison of 15+ payment gateways for SK/CZ e-shops
why_relevant: Maintained, dated (2026) independent comparison naming a long tail of gateways serving SK e-shops — an efficient way to snowball the full actor list (including small domestic players) and to see published fee levels side by side.
